We'll assume apply adds a TSIGRecord to the message, and may throw IllegalArgumentException if inputs invalid.

Thus test cases:

1. Valid Message, old TSIGRecord non-null, fullSignature false -> expect TSIG added with normal signature.

2. Same but fullSignature true -> expect TSIG added with full signature (longer MAC).

3. old null -> expect new TSIG generated based on internal key, no exception.

4. Message null -> expect NullPointerException.

5. TSIGRecord with algorithm unknown -> expect IllegalArgumentException.

6. error code non-zero (e.g., Rcode.FORMERR) -> expect TSIG added with error code set.

7. fullSignature true but old record missing MAC -> expect IllegalStateException.
